steps.name: Arthur
steps.text: Frank. The felt has a stain.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: It's oil. It's a pilot's oil. It's earned.

steps.name: Arthur
steps.text: My father would have it replaced.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Your father has never played on this table. You have. How's the bot?

steps.name: Arthur
steps.text: ...Fine. Perfectly adequate. Why do you ask.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: Because you put a new coat of paint on it. I noticed. It looks good.

steps.name: Arthur
steps.text: It is not paint. It is a finish.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: He's getting better. Don't tell him I said so.
